known_limitations: MetaEditor is unavailable in this environment; compile the three SF14 Expert Advisors on the local Windows terminal.

The MQL5 model registry is deliberately bounded and in-memory; durable publication is represented by append-only Python artifacts and registry snapshots.
Champion or challenger status grants governance eligibility only. It does not load ONNX, authorize a trade, allocate risk, or submit an order.
